body:
## Goal
Update PR #262 so any review synthesis with `Recommended Next Step = HUMAN_DECISION` activates `agent-self-approve` when `AGENT_ALLOW_SELF_APPROVE=true`, regardless of whether the review verdict is `SHIP`, `MINOR_ISSUES`, or `NEEDS_REWORK`.

## Context
PR #262 currently implements a narrower route: `review + SHIP + HUMAN_DECISION + self-approval enabled -> agent-self-approve`, while `HUMAN_DECISION + MINOR_ISSUES` and `HUMAN_DECISION + NEEDS_REWORK` still stop. The requested new behavior is that `HUMAN_DECISION` means the self-approval agent should run as a decision gate for the human judgment, not only for `SHIP` verdicts.

Relevant PR discussion:
- https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/262#issuecomment-4468989346 describes the current concrete implementation plan.
- https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/262#issuecomment-4469005406 summarizes what PR #262 implemented and what it did not implement.
- https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/262#issuecomment-4469260647 clarifies the new requirement: route any `review + HUMAN_DECISION + AGENT_ALLOW_SELF_APPROVE=true` to `agent-self-approve`; keep approval submission safe.

This should be implemented as a fix-pr on PR #262 because that PR already owns the handoff, workflow input, self-approval context, prompt, docs, and test changes.

## Acceptance Criteria
- `review + HUMAN_DECISION + AGENT_ALLOW_SELF_APPROVE=true` dispatches `agent-self-approve` for `SHIP`, `MINOR_ISSUES`, and `NEEDS_REWORK` review verdicts.
- The review verdict and human-decision context are passed into self-approval so the agent can decide whether to approve, request changes, or block.
- `agent-self-approve` can run for non-`SHIP` human-decision cases as a decision gate instead of stopping in preflight solely because the trusted synthesis verdict is not `SHIP`.
- Safety is preserved: the workflow may submit an actual GitHub approval only when the trusted current-head review synthesis verdict is `SHIP`.
- For non-`SHIP` verdicts, self-approval must not approve; it should return `REQUEST_CHANGES` or `BLOCKED` as appropriate.
- Tests cover `HUMAN_DECISION + SHIP`, `HUMAN_DECISION + MINOR_ISSUES`, and `HUMAN_DECISION + NEEDS_REWORK`, including the no-accidental-approval rule for non-`SHIP` cases.
- Update prompts/docs to describe self-approval as the decision gate for review `HUMAN_DECISION`, while preserving the approval safety rule.

---

Requested via issue_comment at https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/262

comments.body:
**Sepo implementation finished**

- Branch: `agent/implement-issue-263/codex-25994524384`
- Pull request: https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/264

Implemented the broader HUMAN_DECISION flow: review syntheses with HUMAN_DECISION now dispatch agent-self-approve whenever self-approval is enabled, including non-SHIP verdicts, while self-approval preflight can run as a decision gate for current-head non-SHIP syntheses and the resolver still prevents actual approval without trusted SHIP provenance. Updated prompts, docs, and focused tests; verified with npm run build, targeted node tests, and git diff --check.

title: Route all HUMAN_DECISION reviews through self-approval
